name: Transparent retry must revalidate attempt-local semantic proofs

payload.description: A successful validation in attempt one is not a certificate for attempt two after a conflicting commit changes the validated resource.
payload.candidate_shape: Attempt one validates P and adds a conflict owner; a competitor invalidates P before prewrite; transparent retry must execute the validation again.
admission_gates: the competitor commits after the first validation
a real storage conflict proves retry rather than ordinary fresh execution
the final state oracle directly detects use of the invalid proof
the expected terminal error is distinguished from generic conflict failure
payload.negative_screen: Executor reconstruction is a holding guard only after the retry witness and semantic error are observed.

provenance.source: FK parent existence invalidated before prewrite

name: FK retry returns semantic error and cannot commit an orphan

payload.red: After the parent delete commits and the writer retries, INSERT returns success or fresh state contains a child without its parent.
payload.green: Retry witness is present; INSERT returns planner error 1452; parent and child are absent; FK anti-join is empty; ADMIN CHECK and child index scan pass.
payload.why_terminal_error_matters: A generic write-conflict error with no child is fail-closed, but does not prove semantic revalidation.

name: Autocommit retry rechecks an FK parent deleted after first validation

payload.source_shape: Plain optimistic autocommit INSERT validates an existing parent and marks its record key for a lock-only mutation; another session deletes the parent before prewrite.
payload.observed: The parent lock-only mutation caused a real TiKV conflict. Transaction replay reran the FK check, returned 1452, and committed no child.
payload.holding_guard: The executor/FKCheckExec and transaction snapshot are rebuilt for autocommit retry; the first attempt's positive existence proof is not reused.

configuration.tidb_disable_txn_auto_retry: default 1, autocommit commit conflict still replayed

payload.reopen_only_if: a different semantic validator stores a positive result outside executor/transaction rebuild or omits the conflict owner that protects invalidation

name: FK parent existence proof must belong to the successful attempt

payload.p_check: Attempt one finds parent id=1 and marks its record key for lock-only prewrite.
payload.q_claim: Any retry after a committed delete must read parent existence again.
payload.f_effect: Reusing the old positive proof would allow a successful INSERT of an orphan child.
payload.result: GREEN: retry returned 1452 and durable FK closure remained empty.

title: Autocommit retry might reuse an FK parent existence proof after parent delete

payload.do_not_repeat: Do not enumerate FK key/index shapes. Move to a different semantic validator or a path with no conflict owner.

rationale: The pause separates first-attempt validation from the invalidating parent delete.
The oracle proves both semantic revalidation and absence of persistent orphan data.
Ordinary FK parent existence is rebuilt; the next candidate needs another validator or a missing conflict owner.

evidence.retry: session retry log for the INSERT and ExecRetryCount >= 1
evidence.durable: parent empty, child empty, anti-join zero, ADMIN CHECK and pid index empty

lessons.guard: FK positive proof and lock-only key are rebuilt on retry.
lessons.selector_refinement: Search for validators whose proof or conflict owner lives outside transaction/executor reconstruction.
lessons.severity_oracle: Successful INSERT plus orphan child would have been direct C3 persistent corruption.
